## 47 CFR Part 9 — 911 requirements

US Federal Communications Commission · US · public domain (US government) — quote freely

<https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-47/chapter-I/subchapter-B/part-9>

**Authoritative for:** The obligations on a multi-line telephone system — direct 911 dialing, on-site notification and dispatchable location. A hard compliance question for anyone administering a phone or conferencing platform in the US, and one that is usually discovered late.

## RFC 3261: SIP — Session Initiation Protocol

IETF · global · **read and cite only — copyrighted, do not reproduce**

<https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3261.html>

Machine-readable: <https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc3550.html>

**Authoritative for:** SIP signaling semantics — dialog and transaction state, response code meanings, registration, and the role of proxies. What an interop dispute between a phone system and a carrier is settled against.

## WebRTC: Real-Time Communication in Browsers

World Wide Web Consortium · global · **read and cite only — copyrighted, do not reproduce**

<https://www.w3.org/TR/webrtc/>

**Authoritative for:** The browser API surface and behavior for real-time audio, video and data — the normative reference for what a conferencing client can and must do.
